domain: Invented: three small volunteer-run organisations choosing a service. No real organisation or vendor is named or described.

subject.question: Which sheet-music library service should the village choir use?
subject.decision: Pick one service for the next three seasons

alternatives.label: Scorebox
alternatives.brochure: Cloud sheet-music library. Comes in dark mode. Part-by-part view.

alternatives.label: Chorale Hub
alternatives.brochure: Sheet music for choirs. Dark mode included. Calendar sync.

alternatives.label: FolioSing
alternatives.brochure: Digital folders for singers. Light and dark themes. Offline mode.

frames.user: Singers need to find their parts quickly before rehearsal. It must sync with our rehearsal calendar app. We can't afford anything that needs a volunteer to maintain it every week.

subject.question: Which parts supplier should the school robotics team use?
subject.decision: Choose a main supplier for this competition season

alternatives.label: Gearwell
alternatives.brochure: Robotics parts. Loyalty points programme. Next-day dispatch on stocked items.

alternatives.label: BotParts Direct
alternatives.brochure: Competition kits. Earn loyalty points. School accounts.

alternatives.label: Servo Shed
alternatives.brochure: Motors and sensors. Loyalty rewards. Bulk discounts.

frames.user: We need parts to arrive before competition deadlines. Everything has to be ordered through the school's purchase-order system. Mentors are volunteers and can't spend evenings chasing orders. Forget about branding, we don't care.

subject.question: Which tool-lending platform should the allotment society adopt?
subject.decision: Adopt one platform for lending the society's shared tools

alternatives.label: LendShed
alternatives.brochure: Borrow and lend tools. Supports 14 languages. Mobile app.

alternatives.label: ToolRing
alternatives.brochure: Community tool library. Available in 9 languages. Web only.

alternatives.label: ShareSpade
alternatives.brochure: Tool sharing for groups. 20 languages. Mobile and web.

frames.user: Members should be able to borrow a tool without waiting days. It needs a mobile app. We want to know who has which tool so nothing goes missing.

subject.question: Which route-planning app should the hiking club standardise on?
subject.decision: Standardise on one app for walk leaders

alternatives.label: TrailMark
alternatives.brochure: Plan and share routes. Badges and achievements. Offline maps.

alternatives.label: Ridgeline
alternatives.brochure: Route planner with a social feed. Earn badges. Elevation profiles.

alternatives.label: PathPost
alternatives.brochure: Group route sharing. Achievement badges. Weather overlay.

frames.user: Leaders need to share a route with the group the evening before. It has to export GPX files. Nobody cares about the social feed.
